metrics.name: active_customers
metrics.label: Active customers
metrics.description: Distinct customers who placed at least one order in the period.

metrics.name: average_order_value
metrics.label: Average order value (pre-tax)
metrics.description: Pre-tax revenue divided by number of orders.

metrics.name: cumulative_revenue
metrics.label: Cumulative revenue (pre-tax)
metrics.description: Running total of pre-tax revenue, as of the end of each period.

metrics.name: item_revenue
metrics.label: Item revenue (list price)
metrics.description: Sum of product list prices across items sold. Use for product-level breakdowns.

metrics.name: new_customers
metrics.label: New customers
metrics.description: Customers placing their first order in the period.

metrics.name: returning_order_share
metrics.label: Share of orders from returning customers
metrics.description: Fraction of orders that were not a customer's first order.

metrics.name: revenue_pre_tax
metrics.label: Revenue (pre-tax)
metrics.description: Sum of order subtotals, excluding sales tax.

metrics.name: revenue_with_tax
metrics.label: Revenue (with tax)
metrics.description: Sum of order totals, including sales tax paid by customers.

metrics.name: store_count
metrics.label: Stores
metrics.description: Number of stores, including stores that have no orders. Combine with order_count by store__store_name to find stores without sales.
